unknown_command: "{name}" is not a command of cleared.
entry_roles: Roles of this image: service, app, broker, install or cleared.
state_missing: The state folder {path} is not there. Run the install from the clone: docker compose -f v2/compose.yaml run --rm install
state_root: The state folder {path} belongs to root, and the sessions would run as root. Run the install from the clone: docker compose -f v2/compose.yaml run --rm install
state_open: Other accounts may write in the state folder {path}. Run chmod go-w {path}, then start Cleared again.
not_owner: This container runs as uid {uid}, and the state folder {path} belongs to uid {owner}.
broker_waiting: The release lock waits for a project: no checkout with .cleared/agents.conf is named yet, by CLEARED_V2_PROJECT_DIR or by the workspace the setup assistant writes. It starts by itself once the repository is connected.
